_doc: D-031 goods roster (14, data-driven) + recipes. Categories: food | raw | processed. Grain is the numeraire (D-030: prices are grain-equivalent ratios; price of grain == 1 by definition). bulkPerUnit is the D-034 transport bulk (grain-equivalent volume/mass per unit; TUNE). depositChannel names the terrain field a settlement's founding deposit roll derives from (T3.2; extraction is endowment-bound, m3-spec 3): moisture (forests/pasture), elevation (quarries/ore), water (clay pits, fish grounds); ores add depositSpread - a wide seeded spread that makes ore geography uneven, the precondition for comparative advantage. Recipes are data (T3.2 registers + validates; T3.3 executes). DIMENSIONAL DECLARATION, corrected at T3.3 (S8 4.1 requirement 2): inputs and laborPerOutput are PER EXECUTION of the recipe, and one execution yields output.qty units. T3.2 wrote inputs-per-output-unit, which contradicts the data it shipped - toolmaking declares bronze 1.0 with qty 2, so under a per-unit reading qty would be decorative and the value-add of toolmaking would vanish. The per-execution reading is what T3.3 implements and what ProductionTests.Recipe_InputsAndLabor_ArePerEXECUTION_NotPerOutputUnit pins exactly (2 tools per bronze). laborPerOutput is person-years per execution, an optional D-020 availability predicate ('requires') - a knowledge gate over published variables, never a calendar date (law 4).

projects.name: granary
projects._doc: M4-D first constructible. Sized to be reachable by a founded settlement within a few turns of deliberate construction allocation, so the labour opportunity cost is observable rather than theoretical. TUNE.

projects.name: workshop
projects._doc: M4-D second constructible, deliberately several times the granary in both materials and labour so a settlement can hold it queued for many turns without any stored timer. TUNE.

projects.name: military university
projects._doc: ADR-033 D6 (docs/institutions-universities.md 3): the five specialized-university projects, one per research.json universityTypes entry, ids 10 + the type key. Each BUILDS building.university and FOUNDS inst.university of its type: both entities gate (the research stage's own reading, D-044 R4), checked by the one availability predicate (ConstructionQuery.IsProjectAvailable). The completed building is counted in Structures; InstitutionsSystem founds the institution the next step (maturity 0). TUNE, reference class: the workshop (60 timber, 40 stone, 8.0 adult-years for a ~50 m2 craft workshop) scaled by floor area to a ~1,500 m2 collegiate complex (hall, library/chapel, lodgings round a quadrangle; INFERRED from high-medieval Oxford/Cambridge colleges), x30; the workshop's tools are its own equipment and do not scale. Founding also requires the host's FOUNDING viability (InstitutionViability.ToFound), checked when the queue head resolves.
